title: Anyone else using AI to prototype TradingView strategies?
author: Jealous_Win2699
selftext:
I've been testing an AI-assisted workflow for prototyping TradingView strategies.

Instead of starting with a blank Pine Editor, I describe the rules first and generate a Pine Script draft.

Then I manually check:

* Repainting issues
* Entry / exit logic
* Position sizing
* Stop loss
* Alerts
* Backtest results

The tool I'm testing is:  
[https://tradingviewai.dev/](https://tradingviewai.dev/)

The interesting part isn't letting AI trade for you. It's getting from an idea to something testable much faster.

Anyone else doing something similar?
